page_title: AUG 4-4 MON | Augsburg v B. Monchengladbach 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Daniel Schlager is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' 4 - 4 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Finn Dahmen no chance!
90+7' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to B. Monchengladbach!
90+6' Referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for B. Monchengladbach. Let’s see what happens!
90+6' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to B. Monchengladbach!
90+5' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+4' Yvandro Borges Sanches (B. Monchengladbach) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
90+4' A cross from Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) heads on.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag. Dion Beljo (Augsburg) is adjudged offside.
90+2' Yvandro Borges Sanches (B. Monchengladbach) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Schlager no option but to blow his whistle.
90+1' That's the end of the game for Niklas Dorsch, who is replaced by Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Here's the change. Florian Neuhaus leaves the pitch and Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.
87' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes.
86' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Yvandro Borges Sanches (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Luca Netz.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch for Nathan Ngoumou.
85' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Flag goes up against Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
83' The game is interrupted. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
80' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets low into the middle of the goal.
76' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
76' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
75' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Alassane Plea will be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
75' Today's match ends for Ko Itakura who will be replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
74' The game is interrupted now, Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' Enrico Maassen prepares a substitution. Sven Michel is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ermedin Demirovic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).
70' A cooling break is underway.
69' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) is caught offside!
68' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
67' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), but one of the defenders gets it clear. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
67' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Finn Dahmen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
61' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Enrico Maassen has decided to substitute Mergim Berisha and he is replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
57' Sven Michel (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

56' What a great effort! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
55' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

55' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
51' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
51' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
51' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
49' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Arne Engels (Augsburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
48' Arne Engels (Augsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
47' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' 3 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Sven Michel (Augsburg) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Jonas Omlin no chance!
45+7' Sven Michel (Augsburg) is going to take the penalty!
45+7' The Augsburg players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
45+4' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Schlager must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Augsburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
45+4' One of the Augsburg players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

45+4' What a poor attempt! Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
45+1' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
44' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
41' 2 - 3 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 2:3.
41' Arne Engels (Augsburg) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
37' 1 - 3 Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Finn Dahmen with a strike into the left side of the goal. He makes it 1:3.
36' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
35' Sven Michel (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jonas Omlin, who smothers the ball.
33' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
32' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
32' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
31' Daniel Schlager couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) and blew his whistle.
29' 1 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
27' 0 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Julian Weigl finds Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball in the roof of the net. 0:2.
26' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
25' The referee blows for a cooling break.
24' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
23' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
23' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!

22' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniel Schlager blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
20' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' It looks like Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

18' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
17' The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
16' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) is able to continue to play.
15' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' 0 - 1 Franck Honorat takes the corner and Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
13' It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.

12' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
8' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
6' The game is interrupted as Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) is flagged offside.
5' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
4' Daniel Schlager has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
2' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! B. Monchengladbach will take the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager will officiate today.
